status: Proposed independent trials, not adopted implementation

trials.title: Avoid shadows with zero direct-light contribution
trials.evidence: Three-view captures are byte-identical. Repeated 1080p rear timing falls from about 20.9 ms to 17.1 ms; front/side improve less. Order-only controls remain close to baseline.
trials.trial: First qualify zero-contribution shadow culling for the eligible opaque one-material lit path. Keep the final bump-normal test and geometric shadow origin. Leave original/general/debug paths available.
trials.risk: Measured only in a private static one-material opaque atmosphere path. Broad appearance/history/optical qualification and exhaustion-policy review remain; all views still miss 16.7 ms.
trials.gate: Do not adopt from visit counts or static images alone. Retain material/debug/transport/history behavior, exhaustion semantics and full lit parity; qualify GPU time and compiled resource cost.

trials.title: Precompute round-cone shape invariants
trials.evidence: Guardian root contains 996 round cones. Every primitive query recomputes shape-only divisions and a square root in authoredPrimitive.
trials.trial: Add an opt-in disposable geometry-derived GPU cache for round-cone invariants, retaining the complete authored program and all CSG operations. Benchmark against unchanged evaluation.
trials.risk: Extra loads/cache footprint can erase arithmetic savings; CPU/GPU rounding can move near-boundary normals. No gain measured yet.
trials.gate: Frozen geometry checks, exact/derived query comparisons, all native view/transport/history controls; then three repeated selected-path timings. Stop on tolerance changes or no useful GPU gain.

trials.title: Guarded larger sphere-tracing steps
trials.evidence: Camera-only diagnostics remain 14.8–20.6 ms; primary and shadow loops use plain abs(d) advancement.
trials.trial: Compare fixed relaxation and author-described adaptive relaxation independently. Keep conservative overlap/backtracking checks and reset learned state across far-certificate advances.
trials.risk: Retries can outweigh saved evaluations. Preserve inside exits, root endpoint rules, hard/smooth CSG, hidden sub-grid features and exact hit/normal tolerances.
trials.gate: Retain current stepping as a fallback; record retries, exact evaluations, exhaustion and GPU time for every view. Do not infer speed from step counts alone.

trials.title: Refine expensive near-surface regional programs
trials.evidence: The unchanged 320p replay gives mean/p95 hit program lengths 78/195 (preset), 37/137 (side), and 25/95 (rear).
trials.trial: First survey axis-64 near-surface cells and a bounded finer child level offline. Forecast active references, lookup overhead, build time and peak live memory before a renderer trial.
trials.risk: A dense 256-cubed 16-byte header table alone is 256 MiB. More build work can worsen the outstanding edit-latency target.
trials.gate: Same exact-field, far-bound and material ownership contracts; explicit allocation/fallback caps. Promote only if total frame time improves without unacceptable publication/memory cost.

trials.title: Optional lower-resolution motion preview
trials.evidence: Native 540p/720p selected-path timings are measured separately from 1080p.
trials.trial: If desired, render the same exact CSG tracer at a smaller image size while moving, then return to full resolution when settled.
trials.risk: Fewer pixels reduce image detail and change procedural filtering. This is not native 1080p optimization or integrated upscale acceptance.
trials.gate: Visual acceptance of edges/thin features and proper native upscaled-frame timing before adoption; preserve full-resolution final mode.

trials.title: Pipeline caching and creation feedback
trials.evidence: Engine graphics pipeline construction passes VK_NULL_HANDLE for the application cache. The prior first windowed material pool took 32.5 seconds; cached pools took tens of milliseconds.
trials.trial: Measure per-pipeline creation feedback, then compare explicit persistent cache reuse with robust device/driver invalidation and clean fallback.
trials.risk: A controlled first-use cache study is still missing. This does not reduce the 21–23 ms steady GPU cost.
trials.gate: Qualify same-device reuse, invalid/corrupt cache fallback, driver/device changes and window recreation; retain prebuilt selection without compiling during edits.

deprioritized: More sky/material splitting: current ablations show little headroom
Reducing the normal stencil first: no compelling isolated timing signal; geometric/CSG-normal risk
GPU builder for FPS: addresses publication latency, not shader execution
Disabling shadows or loosening hit tolerances: changed-output controls, not accepted optimization
Wavefront tracing, mesh proxies and hardware ray tracing: larger representation/pipeline changes before smaller trials
